findings: Fail-closed quarantine verified: all six legacy model workflows are workflow_dispatch-only with SHA-pinned actions, contents:read permissions, no secrets, env-passed inputs (no expression injection), and an unconditional exit-1 'Campaign route required' step; results-validate.yml is hard-disabled via 'if: ${{ false }}'.

Identity bindings are exact: verify() requires a 40-hex source equal to the checked-out HEAD and destination fixed to astra/autonomous-isles-pilot; workflow job 'if' additionally pins github.ref, destination_branch, and the operator-controlled PILOT_REMOTE_RESEARCH_ENABLED variable.

publish() implements a correct append-only compare-and-swap: ls-remote expected-old check, mandatory merge-base --is-ancestor fast-forward proof, and --force-with-lease=<ref>:<expected> closes the TOCTOU window; missing remote ref, all-zero pin, or unfetched objects all fail closed.

Recovery semantics are sound: publish is idempotent after crash-after-push (rerun with expected_remote = source passes all gates as a no-op); no local state mutates on any failure path; concurrency group 'scout-cycle' with cancel-in-progress:false serializes without killing in-flight runs.

Publication audit fails closed on every anomaly (dirty tree, wrong branch, merge commits, disallowed paths, symlink/gitlink modes, binaries/oversize blobs, credential patterns, executed notebook outputs); contaminated-commit check requires exit code exactly 1 so a missing object also fails; deleted-file skip is sound since content was audited at the introducing commit; audit.ROOT swap in publish is restored in finally and read at call time by the inner git helpers.

Scientific approvals preserved: no code path rewrites existing receipts; disposition doc claims match the code and it explicitly states REQUEST_CHANGES is not approval, with remote model routes blocked and separate operator gates retained.

Advisory: the audit allowlist includes its own governing files (scripts/workflow_boundary.py, scripts/check_pilot_publication.py, .github/workflows/*.yml), so published commits could weaken future audits/quarantine at the content level; automatic checks are path/extension/size only, mitigated by operator-run publish and the repo-variable gate. Consider content-level checks or excluding these paths from pilot-authorable changes.
Advisory: publish/audit receipts are printed to stdout only and not persisted as artifacts; first-time remote branch creation is impossible (empty ls-remote fails) — fail-closed but undocumented.

Advisory: allowed prefixes (tests/, campaigns/isles24-pilot/, docs/isles-pilot/) admit arbitrary text files up to 1.5 MB per version, and private-artifact refusal only matches path components starting with 'results'/'staged'/'.private', so privacy for other names depends on the human commit-review step.
